CustomField.formula:
IF (ISBLANK(End_Date_Time__c ), "",
IF(HOUR(End_Date_Time__c ) <= 12, TEXT(HOUR(End_Date_Time__c )), TEXT(HOUR(End_Date_Time__c )-12)) & ":" &
IF (MINUTE(End_Date_Time__c ) < 10, "0" + TEXT(MINUTE(End_Date_Time__c )), TEXT(MINUTE(End_Date_Time__c ))) &
IF (HOUR(End_Date_Time__c ) < 12, " AM", " PM"))
CustomField.label: End Time Formula
